name: Add icon for editing stage prompt
description: Whenever the factory plugin is enabled, show an icon in the header of the column that allows a user to quickly pull up and view/edit the stage prompt. Should automatically open in a fullscreen editor. Modify full-screen editor if required

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 3/10. Working on codex/row-36-stage-prompt-shortcut from origin/main. Plan: add a Plugin-owned Stage-header shortcut, reuse the fullscreen editor to view/edit the selected Stage Prompt, update documentation, run all four required checks, and capture/upload TUI screenshots.
